title: Days Tracker
description: A Minecraft plugin that tracks survival runs with day counting, death logging, milestones, HUD display, and data export features.
body:
A Minecraft Spigot plugin for tracking survival challenges. Players can start runs with a target day count (e.g., 100 days), and the plugin tracks:

Day counter - Tracks current day vs target day with progress percentage
Death tracking - Logs all deaths with player name, day, and cause; broadcasts death messages
Milestone system - Built-in milestones (10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 100, 200, 365, 500, 1000) plus dynamic percentage milestones (25%, 50%, 75%, 100%)
HUD display - Sidebar scoreboard showing day counter, progress bar, deaths, next milestone, run status, and play time
Skip night voting - Players can vote to skip nighttime during runs
Statistics - Detailed run statistics and recaps
Data export - Exports run data to multiple formats (TXT, JSON, CSV)
End screen - Shows run completion summary with fireworks and optional signpost generation
Pause/resume - Ability to pause and resume runs
Configuration - Extensive config options for all features
Commands include /days (main control), /dayshud (HUD controls), and /skipnightvote (voting). Permissions system supports different access levels for players and admins.
